Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Suresh - 30 years, prince, son
Look: golden crown, red royal robe
2. Sanjay - 32 years, friend
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
3. Sonali - 65 years, queen, mother
Look: small crown, pink lehenga
4. Ajay - 38 years, general
Look: armour, a sword at the waist, thick moustache
5. Pallavi - 32 years, princess, daughter
Look: golden jewellery, green royal dress

Places

1. The royal court - tall pillars, a golden throne

Scene 1: The royal court - Day

[Suresh stands in the court. Sonali stands near him.]

Suresh: "Let's do something fun today."

[Suresh sits down on the throne.]

Sonali: "What happened?"

[Suresh unrolls the royal scroll and reads it aloud.]

Suresh: "What happened?"

[Suresh drinks the poisoned wine and dies.]

Sonali: "Rest in peace."
